title: multi-Purpose Canine
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: Capabilities: SOF multi-Purpose Canine (MPCs) are capable of Explosives Detection, Apprehension (Bite Work), and Human Tracking. SOF MPCs are specifically selected for not only their core capabilities but their resilience in any environment as they are expected to operate like a Special Forces Soldier conducting activities such as roping from helicopters, conducting CQB clearance operations with SF operators, conduct mounted and dismounted patrols, and be neutral to gunfire at least at a base level when purchased.Age: 1yrBreed: Belgian Malinois
